name: sreeragh-s-mucode
description: mucode is an open source terminal AI coding workspace for running multiple coding agents from one focused TUI. It gives you one local interface for: Codex Claude Code OpenCode pi-ai backed API providers The project is built with Bun, React, and OpenTUI.
